analysis:
The only change in this PR is a one-line documentation edit in docs/architecture/inference.md (head/base line 1846), in the `stop` row of the sampling-parameter table. It now says GPT-OSS scopes stop-string matching to the Harmony `final` message, via `ModelEOSPolicy.stopStringScope`, so analysis and tool-call frames never match. It also says the reported sequence replays the same scope. The two supplied units are unchanged surrounding text from the same file (lines 2428-2961, MiMo, Flint and invariants sections). I found no edit there, so I treated it as context only.

There are no source, config, crypto or wire changes, and no changes to trust boundaries, keys, attestation or cache storage. The relevant retained definition, T-041 (prefix-cache storage), is not touched. The doc change describes behavior that narrows where client stop strings can end a request, which is not a regression for TB-002 or TB-007. The statement cannot be checked here because the implementing Swift files (`ModelEOSPolicy`, `StopHoldback`, `EngineV2Bridge+StopSequence.swift`) were not supplied.

Remaining question for integration: confirm that the code change behind this doc update matches the claim. Specifically, that the stop-sequence scoping cannot leak withheld analysis or tool-call text through the reported sequence, and that holdback of partial matches does not alter the first-content deadline or encryption paths. Nothing in the supplied evidence suggests a problem. Coverage limit: only documentation was examined.
